non_claims: This is an independent verification of three frozen Asqav vectors, not the complete Asqav corpus.
Wire-level receipt validity does not prove capture completeness.
A gap marker does not prove the missing actions were policy-evaluated or executed.
A blocked-emission receipt proves prevention only under a separately justified non-bypassable enforcement assumption.
This report is interoperability evidence, not certification or endorsement.

vectors.claim_ceiling: receipt-chain integrity only; capture completeness remains unproven without independent effect evidence
the signed gap reports missing receipt emission; it does not prove the unsigned actions were evaluated or executed
the lifecycle receipt makes the blocked interval visible; prevention of every external effect still depends on a non-bypassable enforcement point
